facts.fact: Croissance Afrique reports that the APDP served formal notices for non-compliance with Law No. 2013-015 on personal data protection, which is therefore being applied.
The APDP held its first extraordinary session in March 2025 and pronounced sanctions, according to Croissance Afrique.

At its March 2025 session the APDP served formal notices on 100 named structures, including schools, hotels, firms and an NGO, for failing to make declarations, threatening fines of 5 to 20 million FCFA.
